alpha_interpretation: zero-alpha prior because the exact selection pipeline has no independent point-in-time OOS evidence; zero is an assumption, not an observed absence of alpha
beta_ensemble_policy: equal-weight 1/3/5-year window estimates, no return-based optimization; overlapping windows are not independent evidence

market_prior_source.interpretation: sum is a long-horizon valuation-implied required return; applying its square-root gross return to six months is an analyst baseline assumption, not a calibrated six-month S&P 500 forecast

short_rate_source.interpretation: benchmark rate, not the user's deposit yield or an executable bill quote; approximate six-month cash return 2% before costs

portfolio_policy: current initial weights, no re-selection; first-order six-month horizon-return approximation; risk calculated from daily constant-weight exposures, no executable historical strategy backtest
benchmark: S&P 500 total return; SPY adjusted prices used as historical market proxy
benchmark_proxy_limit: SPY includes fund fees and tracking differences; it is not the exact S&P 500 total return index
cost_policy: headline estimates before transaction costs, tax and FX; separately show portfolio-only 10 and 25 bps one-way execution-cost sensitivities, not known broker quotes
